notes:
## 0.2.222

owes: none — build and agent tooling only: `tooling/` re-pinned v0.1.12 → v0.1.18 and the `preflight@` ref in `release.yml` follows (Tooling's interval is `owes: none` for this repository: no `tooling.conf` value holds `$`, a backquote or `;`, and the hook block already matches the template); no image content, key, default or URL changes.
owes: none — `syncprotocol` and `synccore` re-pinned 0.10.3 → 0.10.5, `feedcore`, `weathercore` and `stockscore` 0.5.28 → 0.5.30 (SyncCore's and DataCore's intervals are `owes: none`: parser, codec and merge-policy hardening, no wire or API change).
owes: none — `feedcore`, `weathercore` and `stockscore` re-pinned 0.5.30 → 0.5.31 (DataCore's interval adds public stocks API only, which nothing here consumes yet).
owes: none — a `/sync/pull` page now also ends at 8 MiB of payload (at least one record, `more = true`); the wire format is unchanged and a client already follows `more`.
owes: none — a browser's same-origin sign-in carrying `Origin: null` is accepted again (`Sec-Fetch-Site` decides alone when present); a browser refused as cross-site gets `/login` with a sentence instead of a bare `403`; the sign-in name field reads *Username* (five locales); no migration, key, wire format or default changes.
owes: none — every page outside the reader and the pending-update About page now answers `script-src 'none'; connect-src 'none'` (it listed all five script hashes before); a page lists only the scripts it embeds; no migration, key, wire format or default changes.
owes: a `PUT` to `/files/` above 1 MiB now reaches the hub (the declared-length reject no longer applies there; the live upload cap and the 2 GiB backstop do) — a reverse proxy must allow that body size on that path; a `PROPFIND` now percent-encodes each path segment of its `D:href`.
owes: a stored `EGRESS_ALLOW_HOSTS` holding an address or range (`/`, `:` or a bare IPv4) now stops the hub at start, as the environment value always did — edit it to a host name first; the sign-in address behind a trusted proxy now reads every `X-Forwarded-For` header line, not just the first.
owes: a snapshot restore now also deletes `files/<id>` and the `blobs/` files only claimed by accounts the snapshot lacks (it left them on disk before) — copy anything wanted from a removed account first; no migration.
owes: none — log lines only: a collection name on a sync line is cut to 64 characters with control characters shown as `?`, and the update check, notes sweep and mDNS responder log exception class names instead of messages; the five credential helpers in `auth/` are one `Tokens` object with the same lengths; the unscoped record count is gone; no migration, key, wire format or default changes.
owes: none — the forecast board draws its condition art from twelve SVGs served at `/static/weather/{name}` (public, `ETag` + `no-cache`, enumerated names only); no migration, key or default changes.
owes: the hub now writes `stocks.portfolio`: a person whose phone has already sent a portfolio can import a bank statement at `/stocks/portfolio/import`, and the records it writes reach the phone by the next pull; `com.mambocoding.stocks:core` stays at 0.5.31; no migration, key or default changes.
owes: `.env` is no longer tracked — the template ships as `.env.example`, copied to `.env` beside `compose.yml` before the first `docker compose up -d`; an existing checkout keeps its `.env` only if it is copied aside before the update that removes it, and a running install that has its own `.env` needs nothing.
